verdict.rationale: Mintlify is a SaaS documentation platform with built-in AI features (assistant, agent, automations), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documented setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Self-hosting and the vague 'Enterprise security & legal' pricing line are adjacent features, not a documented training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
